To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the developed LDMO S inverter and charge pump are able to drive the RF-MEMS switches in a BiCMOS technology and the RF-MEMS actuated SPDT switch is able to switch between the two RF paths.
a high voltage LDMO inverter has been designed, which enables the on-chip actuation of an RF-MEMS SPST switch.
the developed high voltage BiCMOS LDMOS invertor enables the RF-MEMS actuator to switch the RF-MEMS switches with a very fast switching time.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and implementation of a high voltage LDMO inverter for RF-MEMS actuations.
the development of high voltage LDMOs circuits for on-chip MEMS actuation in a SiGe:C Bi-CMOS process.
the development of high voltage LDMOs inverter circuits for on-chip control of high frequency MEMS devices.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presented high voltage LDMOs inverter is a promising candidate for the actuation of RF-MEMS devices.
this work demonstrates the first fully integrated on-chip high voltage LDMO inverter for onchip actuation of RF-MEMS switches in a SiGe:C Bi CMOS process.
this is the first time that a high voltage LDMO inverter has been designed and implemented for RF-MEMS actuator control in the 0.25-μm SiGe:C technology.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully demonstrated the first on-chip RF actuation of an RF-MEMS SP4T switch using a BiCMOS technology, which is a key step towards fully-integrated RF-MEMS circuits.
the developed high voltage LDMOs inverter and charge pump are able to drive the RF-MEMS devices and the RF-MEMS switches can be successfully controlled by the developed circuit.
we developed a fully integrated BiCMOS circuit, including high voltage LDMO inverters and RF-MEMS SPST switch, that can be used as a building block for future RF-MEMS based RF front ends.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the developed LDMO inverters enable the on-chip actuation of the MEMS switches and thus the possibility to integrate MEMS devices with CMOS circuits in a single chip.
the proposed high voltage LDMoS inverter is a viable alternative to the traditional CMOS inverter for the control of high voltage actuators such as RF-MEMS switches.
the proposed high voltage LDMOs inverters can be used as a driver for RF-MEMS devices in BiCMOS technology.
